author: GameTrailers
description:
Check out the Steam Playtest Launch Trailer for FOAMGRAVE, an ocean survival sandbox developed by 
TriadPixel. Build a floating home in a drowned world. Customize your cabin and deck, gather resources, craft supplies, and battle pirate ships. Sail solo or with friends in a 3D ocean survival sandbox with player-hosted multiplayer and optional PvP. FOAMGRAVE is coming soon to PC (Steam), with an open playtest available now on Steam.
title: FOAMGRAVE - Official Steam Playtest Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Check out the announcement trailer for Meowsical Nights: Cat Music Puzzles, an indie puzzle game developed by AVGAM. Meowsical Nights: Cat Music Puzzles is a cozy music puzzle and sandbox game where your ears lead the way. Listen closely to catchy tracks, audition adorable feline musicians, and put together the purr-fect band on stage—or take full creative control and compose your own music from scratch. Meowsical Nights: Cat Music Puzzles is coming soon to PC (Steam).
title: Meowsical Nights: Cat Music Puzzles - Official Announcement Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Don't miss the Freya Skill Overview trailer for Monster Hunter Outlanders, a mobile open-world action RPG developed by TiMi Studio Group. Freya wields a great sword with masterful control. She parries while sheathed and builds up Inner Flame while maneuvering to find openings. Some moves allow her to detonate Inner Flame while maneuvering with the weapon sheathed, unleashing a powerful slash. Monster Hunter Outlanders is available now for iOS and Android.
title: Monster Hunter Outlanders - Official Freya Skill Overview Trailer
